scenes.headline: How a small open image model reads a layout
scenes.sub: FLUX 3 Image Klein: three streams, one trunk, boxes as text
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Easel! FLUX 3 Image Klein is Black Forest Labs' new open image model. Here's how it follows a layout.

scenes.text: Prompt, references and the noisy image start as separate streams, then share one trunk. Layout boxes ride along as JSON inside the caption.
scenes.say: The idea: prompt, references and the noisy image start as separate streams, then share one trunk. The layout boxes are just text in the caption.

steps.say: First, the caption, layout boxes included, is read by a four billion parameter vision language model. As plain text.
Reference images and the noisy image become tokens. Each stream gets five private blocks, attending only to itself.
Then twenty-eight shared blocks attend across everything at once, and predict where the image should move next.

scenes.credit: Black Forest Labs, reference repository README
scenes.title: Boxes in, picture out

steps.say: Four labelled boxes become a facade, with the chimney and balconies where they were drawn.
One box places an egg chair in a real room. The boxes guide placement. They are not a hard mask.

scenes.title: Sixteen steps, no guidance
scenes.text: x' = x + (t' - t) v(x, t, t')
scenes.say: The fast model is a flow map.

parts.note: the network also sees where the step lands
parts.say: Its network is told both the current noise level and where the step will land.

parts.note: a big jump, not a small step
parts.say: So it predicts the average motion over a big jump. The last step goes straight to a clean image.

scenes.title: 8 GB, one stage at a time
scenes.say: The eight gigabyte claim is real arithmetic, with the int eight files.

items.say: Encode the caption with the text encoder.
Then load the image model and sample. Both together would not fit.

scenes.text: Klein is the FLUX 3 trunk with three streams, and its layout control is text the encoder reads.

scenes.say: To recap: private blocks, then a shared trunk. Boxes as text. And a flow map for speed.
